spanish: Y desde entonces que vine a Faraón a hablar en tu nombre, ha hecho mal a este pueblo, y librando, no has librado a tu pueblo.

findings.issue: Spanish inserts complementizer 'que' between מֵאָז and בָּאתִי; Hebrew has no relative particle (grammatical smoothing only).

notes: Infinitive absolute + finite נצל kept as librando / no has librado; persons and participants match the tokens.
